nl.title: Wat verbruikt opslag in mijn hostingpakket?
nl.excerpt: Wat schijfruimte verbruikt: sites, mail, backups, databases en logs.
nl.bodyHtml:
Schijf = som van webfiles, mailboxes, DB’s, backups en soms snapshots.

Voorbereiding

  • File Manager + backuplijsten

Stappen

  1. Meet public_html groottes
  2. Check mail usage
  3. Check MySQL sizes
  4. Check backup/JetBackup/Installatron sets
  5. Ruim gericht op

Controleren

  • Topverbruikers geïdentificeerd

Tip: Logs kunnen groeien zonder dat je het merkt.

Let op: Dubbele full backups eten packs leeg.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: prevent-full; backup-da.

en.title: What verbruikt storage in my hosting plan?
en.excerpt: Files in DirectAdmin File Manager: correct folder, permissions, .htaccess; check disk/inodes.
en.bodyHtml:
“What verbruikt storage in my hosting plan”: work in DirectAdmin → File Manager in the correct user/domain path (often domains/…/public_html).

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin login
  • Path to the site
  • Backup for .htaccess/permissions

Steps

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin → System Info & Files → File Manager.
  2. Navigate to domains/yourdomain/public_html (or the intended subdirectory).
  3. For .htaccess/security: edit or create .htaccess; for folder passwords use Password Protected Directories.
  4. Keep permissions conservative (files ~644, folders ~755) — not 777.
  5. If disk/inodes are full: remove caches, old backups and large logs; empty File Manager Trash.
  6. Test the URL in a private window.

Verify

  • Site/folder behaves as intended
  • No 500 from a broken .htaccess

Tip: Download a copy of .htaccess before experimenting.

Note: Do not delete wp-config or .env ‘to free space’.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: FTP/SFTP, backups, PHP errors.
